- Ben: confirm impact to delivery milestones and flag any contractual SLA risks.

- Tue (5/4): internal alignment + legal and people ops thumbs-up
- Wed (5/5): confidential manager 1:1s begin (Monica)
- Fri (5/7): final assignments & comm plan ready
